records.subject: Still want to get Clearwater Systems set up on Wrenfield?
records.body:
Hi Maya,

Following up to see how things are going. If Wrenfield isn't the right fit, that's useful to know too -- either way I'd appreciate a reply.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Clearwater Systems!
records.body:
Hi Maya,

Thanks for signing up for Wrenfield. Two things that help teams get going: create a project, and invite at least one teammate from Account Settings -> Members.

Happy to answer anything.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.text: New signup alert -- *Clearwater Systems* just created a workspace on starter.

decisions.rationale: Positive signals: first project reached day 1 [email:dc5062f7 follow-through] and onboarding call held as scheduled [calendar:0fde349c]. But no invite sent, no key milestone by day 6, no inbound questions or tickets, and only 8 days left; engaged-but-quiet Starter accounts often drift.

draft.subject: Next step after our onboarding call
draft.body:
Hi Maya,

Thanks for making time for the onboarding call last week. You've already created your first project in Wrenfield, which is the main organizing unit, with tasks living inside them.

The usual next step is getting a teammate in alongside you. A teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time if you'd rather add a few at once.

Would a short call this week help? I'm glad to walk through that first step with you.

Best,
Chidi
